opening: I have sores on my skin.
One is on the shaft of my penis and a similar one is on my left middle finger. I don't have any others like them anywhere on my body.
In my home country I was treated for syphilis, but the treatment was unsuccessful.
I recently immigrated to the US from Africa.
I smoke 2 packs of cigarettes a day, and have for the last 30 years.
